about: Mountain View County is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding the separate towns of Olds, Didsbury, Carstairs, and Sundre—not those towns themselves. Foothills farmland, oil and gas acreages, and Highway 2 / 22 corridors share the landscape between Calgary and Red Deer. About 14,000 people live in Mountain View County.
